name: codex-dsh-team-toolkit
description: Non-payload release layout. The managed payload set is declared by release/payload-inventory.json (the toolkit-owned source of truth); this file describes the toolkit infrastructure that must always be packaged.
payloadInventoryRules: The release inventory is toolkit-owned at release/payload-inventory.json: only paths declared there are installed as managed payload files.
A payload-side COPY_FILE_LIST.json is not an inventory: it does not exist in this toolkit and is never packaged, installed or consulted. The only inventory is release/payload-inventory.json.
Undeclared files present in payload/ (stray files, build leftovers, metadata) are reported and excluded unless -IncludeUndeclaredPayload is passed.
A declared path that is missing from payload/ stops the build: the managed set is never guessed.
No checksum artefact is produced or packaged: there is no SHA256SUMS.txt and no .sha256 sidecar. Release transport integrity belongs to the distribution channel, not to the toolkit.
No other source metadata (build reports, editor files) is packaged.
